# Jora Mechanical Systems

> Licensed heating, cooling, hot water and plumbing contractor serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada — every city and town in Toronto, Peel, York, Halton and Durham. Phone 905-667-2823, email info@joramechanicalsystems.com, emergency service 24/7. Free in-home quotes.

Licensing: TSSA Registered, 313D Licensed, HRAI Certified, G2 Gas Technician, Ontario Building Code, Permits Pulled, WSIB Covered, Fully Insured.
Brands installed: Lennox, Carrier, Trane, KeepRite, Goodman, Kepler, TOSOT, Midea, Gree, Rinnai, Navien, Rheem, Bradford White, Noritz, AirMax.

## Services
- [Furnace installation & replacement](https://joramechanical.github.io/furnaces/): New high-efficiency gas furnaces, sized for your home and installed to Ontario code by licensed gas technicians.
- [Air conditioner installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/air-conditioners/): Quiet, efficient central air — sized properly, installed cleanly, and backed by licensed refrigeration technicians.
- [Heat pump installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/heat-pumps/): One system that heats and cools. Cold-climate heat pumps keep working deep into Ontario winters — and many qualify for rebates.
- [Tankless water heaters](https://joramechanical.github.io/tankless-water-heaters/): Endless hot water, more floor space and lower standby losses. We install condensing tankless units from the top brands.
- [Air handlers & combo systems](https://joramechanical.github.io/air-handlers/): Hydronic air handlers use hot water from your tankless or boiler to heat your home — and add central air conditioning in the same cabinet.
- [24/7 heating & cooling repair](https://joramechanical.github.io/hvac-repair/): No heat, no cooling or no hot water? Call 905-667-2823 any time — day, night, weekends and holidays.
- [Water heater replacement](https://joramechanical.github.io/water-heaters/): Tank water heaters replaced fast — gas, propane or electric — plus help getting out of rental contracts.
- [Garage & workshop heaters](https://joramechanical.github.io/garage-heaters/): A warm garage or workshop all winter — gas unit heaters, radiant tube heaters or electric heaters, installed safely.
- [Ductwork design & installation](https://joramechanical.github.io/ductwork/): Even the best furnace or heat pump can't keep you comfortable through undersized, leaky ducts. We design, build and fix ductwork.
- [Whole-home humidifiers](https://joramechanical.github.io/humidifiers/): Ontario winters make indoor air very dry. A humidifier on your furnace adds moisture to every room automatically.
- [Smart thermostats](https://joramechanical.github.io/smart-thermostats/): Control your comfort from your phone and save energy with schedules and away modes. Rebates may apply.
- [Plumbing services](https://joramechanical.github.io/plumbing/): Leaks, drains, fixtures and water lines — handled by the same team you trust with your heating and cooling.
- [HRV & ERV ventilation](https://joramechanical.github.io/hrv-erv/): Bring in fresh air and send stale air out — while recovering most of the heat. Ideal for newer, tightly-built homes.
- [Boilers & radiant heating](https://joramechanical.github.io/boilers/): Quiet, even heat for radiators and in-floor systems — including combi boilers that also make your hot water.
- [Indoor air quality](https://joramechanical.github.io/indoor-air-quality/): Better filtration and purification on your existing system — for allergies, pets, renovation dust and wildfire smoke.
- [Maintenance & tune-ups](https://joramechanical.github.io/hvac-maintenance/): A yearly tune-up keeps your system safe and efficient, catches small problems early and helps keep warranties valid.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://joramechanical.github.io/commercial-hvac/): Rooftop units, make-up air, unit heaters and ventilation for shops, offices, restaurants, clinics and plazas.
- [Industrial HVAC](https://joramechanical.github.io/industrial-hvac/): Heating and ventilation for warehouses, workshops and plants — radiant tube heaters, make-up air, exhaust and gas lines.

## Products
- [Lennox Elite EL296V Gas Furnace](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/lennox-el296v/): Two-stage, variable-speed comfort with up to 96% AFUE.
- [Lennox Signature SLP99V Gas Furnace](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/lennox-slp99v/): Lennox's premium modulating furnace — up to 99% AFUE.
- [Carrier Comfort 96 Gas Furnace (59SC6)](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/carrier-59sc6/): Reliable Carrier heat with up to 97% AFUE.
- [Trane S9V2-VS Gas Furnace](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/trane-s9v2/): 97% AFUE, two-stage, variable-speed — built tough.
- [KeepRite Ion 96 Gas Furnace (G96CTN)](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/keeprite-g96ctn/): Canadian cold-climate comfort, up to 96.7% AFUE.
- [Goodman GMVC96 Gas Furnace](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/goodman-gmvc96/): 96% AFUE two-stage furnace — strong value.
- [Kepler High-Efficiency Gas Furnace](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/kepler-furnace/): Modern design, steady efficient warmth.
- [Lennox Elite EL16XC1 Air Conditioner](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/lennox-el16xc1/): Quiet, efficient central air — up to 17 SEER.
- [Carrier Performance Air Conditioner (26SPA6)](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/carrier-26spa6/): Up to 16.5 SEER2 with Carrier reliability.
- [KeepRite Ion 17 Air Conditioner (CCA7)](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/keeprite-cca7/): Two-stage comfort, up to 17 SEER.
- [Trane XV18 Variable-Speed Air Conditioner](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/trane-xv18/): Variable-speed TruComfort cooling, quiet as 55 dB.
- [Kepler Central Air Conditioner](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/kepler-ac/): Clean, modern outdoor unit for steady summer comfort.
- [Lennox Elite EL18KSLV Heat Pump](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/lennox-el18kslv/): Slim side-discharge cold-climate heat pump, made for Canada.
- [TOSOT APEX Central Heat Pump](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/tosot-apex/): Inverter central heat pump that heats down to −30 °C.
- [Midea Inverter Heat Pump](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/midea-hp/): Efficient inverter heating & cooling for rooms or whole homes.
- [Gree Ductless Mini-Split Heat Pump](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/gree-minisplit/): Cools and heats rooms with no ductwork.
- [AirMax MaxAir e-Series Air Handlers](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/airmax-e/): Four sizes, from small condos to larger homes.
- [Navien NPE-240A2 Tankless Water Heater](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/navien-npe240a2/): Built-in recirculation for hot water faster.
- [Rinnai RX199iN Condensing Tankless](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/rinnai-rx199in/): Up to 11.1 GPM and 0.98 UEF, Wi-Fi built in.
- [Rheem Super High Efficiency Tankless](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/rheem-ikonic/): Condensing tankless with built-in recirculation.
- [Bradford White Infiniti GS 199 Tankless](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/bw-infiniti-gs/): Made-tough condensing tankless, 199,000 BTU.
- [Noritz EZ Series EZTR50 Tankless](https://joramechanical.github.io/products/noritz-eztr50/): Drop-in replacement for a 50-gallon tank.
